ja:
16:8 TR本文は「急いで」を加えている。
16:8 一つの孤立した写本は9-20節を省くが、8節の末尾に次の「マルコによる福音書の短い結び」を加えている。彼女たちは命じられたことをすべて、ペテロの周りにいた人々に手短に伝えた。その後、イエスご自身が彼らを遣わし、東から西まで、永遠の救いについての神聖で朽ちることのない宣言を伝えさせられた。
en:
16:8 TR adds “quickly”
16:8 One isolated manuscript omits verses 9-20 but adds this “short ending of Mark” to the end of verse 8: They told all that had been commanded them briefly to those around Peter. After that, Jesus himself sent them out, from east to west, with the sacred and imperishable proclamation of eternal salvation.

zh: 向抹大拉的馬利亞顯現

p.src: 9  Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

ja: く、イエスはよみがえり、まずマグダラのマリアに
en: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
u.src: 9  Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

ja: 16:9 NU本文には9-20節の本文が含まれているが、少数の写本ではこれが省かれていると脚注に記している。世界英語聖書の翻訳者たちは、権威あるギリシャ語多数本文新約聖書だけでなく、TR本文やNU本文が引用する多くの写本を含む圧倒的多数の本文証拠に基づき、マルコによる福音書16:9-20を信頼できるものとみなしている。
en: 16:9 NU includes the text of verses 9-20, but mentions in a footnote that a few manuscripts omitted it. The translators of the World English Bible regard Mark 16:9-20 as reliable based on an overwhelming majority of textual evidence, including not only the authoritative Greek Majority Text New Testament, but also the TR and many of the manuscripts cited in the NU text.

ja: 々が嘆き悲しんで泣いているところへ行き、そのことを知らせた。
en: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

u.src: 11  When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.
